decisions_taken: | 20a | ResultHttpResult<T, TError>; Result<T> -> <T, Error>; Validation -> <T, ValidationFailed<...>>; internal ctor (spec: 8329250) | #39 q11 default; 20b's OpenAPI reads statuses from TError |

| 20a | No Resultful.Text.Json dependency | target project has none; avoids [RequiresDynamicCode] (12b) |

| 20a | Per error in Causes(): exact-type entry, then the built-in ValidationFailed 400 (top-level error only), then base-type entries nearest first; first error with any status wins | 'first mapped type wins' with leaf overrides; Map<Error> doesn't swallow validation |

| 20a | Built-in 400 only when the result's own error is the ValidationFailed; deeper in Causes() only explicit Map entries match | review: a wrapped validation failure must not turn a server error into a 400 exposing inner messages |
| 20a | 5xx checked before the validation branch: ValidationFailed mapped to 5xx writes the plain 5xx problem | review: no validation messages in a 5xx |
| 20a | Any 5xx hides Message outside Development; Development detail = Error.ToString(); no IHostEnvironment = Production | HTTP-500-NOLEAK for every server error |

| 20a | Every 5xx logged once at Error (category Resultful.AspNetCore.ResultHttpResult, event 1 ResultServerError) with Error.ToString(); 4xx not logged | review: hidden errors must be visible; ToString never prints leaf properties |
| 20a | 4xx detail = matched error's Message, only when an entry or the built-in 400 matched; 4xx DefaultStatusCode gives no detail | review nit 7 |
| 20a | Map/DefaultStatusCode accept 400-599 only; null ValidationKey result = "" | a failure must not answer 2xx/3xx; no null key |
| 20a | instance = PathBase + Path (no query); traceId = Activity.Current?.Id ?? TraceIdentifier | contract shape list; query may hold personal data |
